content.text:
This is a great question about **soft brand collections** — a fast-growing segment of the hotel industry that gives owners the best of both worlds: brand affiliation and preserved individuality. Here is a comprehensive overview of the most commonly considered hotel brands in North America for this purpose:

---

## 🏨 What Are Soft Brands?

citations.title: What Is a Soft Brand and Is it of Real Value?

content.text: A soft-branded hotel has a franchise affiliation that primarily relies on its own identity rather than that of the franchise or "brand," but benefits from the connection to the global distribution system (GDS) and central reservation system (CRS) among other resources for support.

citations.cited_text: Properties affiliated with the soft brand "retain independence in branding and operating decisions as well as regional, cultural, and architectural di...
citations.title: Affiliation with the Soft Brand: Pros and Cons

content.text: Properties affiliated with soft brands "retain independence in branding and operating decisions as well as regional, cultural, and architectural distinctions that give them local charm." Hotel owners get access to the brand's benefits but maintain individuality.
As a Cornell Hotel Administration professor put it,

citations.cited_text: “They are designed to offer the best of both worlds: individuality plus the commercial engine of a major brand,” he said, propping up their brilliance...
citations.title: Softening up: Why hotels turn to soft brands and affiliation networks - HOTELSMag.com

content.text: "They are designed to offer the best of both worlds: individuality plus the commercial engine of a major brand."

---

## 🏷️ The Major Soft Brand Collections in North America

content.text: Hyatt's **Unbound Collection** is designed specifically for independent hotels that want brand distribution without standardizing their identity.

### 4. **IHG Hotels & Resorts**
IHG offers several soft brand options.

content.text: IHG's **Vignette Collection** is a premium soft brand aimed at distinctive, independent luxury and upper-upscale hotels that want to retain their individuality while benefiting from IHG's distribution and loyalty ecosystem.
More recently,

### 5. **Wyndham Hotels & Resorts**

content.text: Wyndham has two soft brands: the **Registry Collection** in the luxury space, and **Trademark by Wyndham** in the upper midscale/upscale space.

content.text: Trademark is described as "a growth engine for Wyndham," with about 25 Trademark properties opening in North America in a recent year.

---

### 6. **Choice Hotels**

citations.cited_text: Other prominent hotel chains have also embraced the concept of soft brand collections, including Best Western with its BW Premier Collection and BW Si...
citations.title: Maximizing investment returns on soft brand hotels | Hotel Management

content.text: Choice Hotels embraced the soft brand concept with its **Ascend Hotel Collection**.

This is one of the earlier and more widely accessible soft brand options, spanning the midscale to upscale segments.

---

### 7. **Voluntary Chains / Consortia** *(an alternative path)*

citations.cited_text: Many hotel owners value their independence and need only some of the brand's offerings. For them, joining a consortium could be the best option (Carlb...
citations.title: Affiliation with the Soft Brand: Pros and Cons

content.text: Many hotel owners value their independence and need only some of a brand's offerings. For them, joining a **consortium** could be the best option — a group of independent hotels joined together to improve certain aspects of operation, where hotels benefit from joined resources and are **not** required to follow brand standards.

citations.cited_text: Examples: The Leading Hotels of the World (LHW), Preferred Hotels & Resorts, Small Luxury Hotels of the World (SLH), Historic Hotels of America. Targe...
citations.title: Should Your Independent Hotel Join a Soft Brand Collection? - White Sky Hotel Consultancy & Training

content.text: Examples include **The Leading Hotels of the World (LHW)**, **Preferred Hotels & Resorts**, **Small Luxury Hotels of the World (SLH)**, and **Historic Hotels of America** — options typically targeted at family offices, high-net-worth individuals, and "emotional" asset owners who prioritize legacy, prestige, and operational freedom.

---

## 📊 Summary Table

| Brand Parent | Soft Brand(s) | Segment |
|---|---|---|
| **Marriott** | Autograph Collection, The Luxury Collection, Tribute Portfolio, Design Hotels | Upscale → Luxury |
| **Hilton** | Curio Collection, Tapestry Collection, LXR | Upper-Upscale → Luxury |
| **Hyatt** | Unbound Collection | Upscale → Luxury |
| **IHG** | Vignette Collection, Noted Collection | Upscale → Upper-Upscale |
| **Wyndham** | Trademark Collection, Registry Collection | Upper-Midscale → Luxury |
| **Choice Hotels** | Ascend Hotel Collection | Midscale → Upscale |
| **Consortia** | LHW, Preferred Hotels, SLH, etc. | Varies (often luxury) |
